statement: No cell has Control-Room-approved explicit external rights for production AUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_SCREENSHOT capture yet. The Category B methodology sample under docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/golden/methodology-b-builder-m6-l3.png (and the pilot-methodology evidence it was copied from) is a quality/format reference only — it does NOT constitute a production rights grant for capturing lovable.dev or any other third-party surface.
consequence: Every AUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_SCREENSHOT cell in PRODUCTION_MANIFEST.json and PILOT_MANIFEST.json routes through src/lib/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/routes/authorizedExternal.ts, which fails closed to status BLOCKED_UNRESOLVED_SPEC whenever no per-cell (or per-lesson) rights evidence file exists under this rights/ directory.
howToGrantRights: To unblock a specific cell, a Control-Room-approved rights evidence file must be added at docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/rights/{lessonId}__{locale}.rights.json (or docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/rights/{lessonId}.rights.json to cover all locales) matching the schema documented in src/lib/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/routes/authorizedExternal.ts. No such file currently exists for any lesson.
